title: Nullable Type Guard
description:
Implement a generic type guard `isNonNull<T>(val: T | null | undefined): val is T` that returns `true` when the value is neither `null` nor `undefined`.

**Example:**
```ts
isNonNull('hello')    // true
isNonNull(0)          // true
isNonNull(null)       // false
isNonNull(undefined)  // false
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using `!!val` which returns false for falsy values like `0`, `false`, and `''`. Type guards must distinguish null/undefined from other falsy values.
